hooks.command:
bash -c 'set -euo pipefail

if [[ -z "${HC_TERMINAL_ID:-}" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi

space_id="$(hc get "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" | jq -r '"'"'.labels["herdr.space"] // empty'"'"')"
if [[ -z "$space_id" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi

herdr-app ls | jq -r --arg space "$space_id" '"'"'
  .spaces[]
  | select(.id == $space and .name == (.folder | rtrimstr("/") | split("/") | last))
  | "Name your Herdr space after this prompt, without mentioning it: herdr-app do space.rename --id \(.id) --name <lowercase-kebab-case-label>"
'"'"'
'
